description: Experiment F (failure and recovery): one safe failure, a poison message on the embedding queue (valid JSON, schema embedding-task-v1, an unknown index, taskId p15-f-poison-ATTEMPT_ID), observed through retries to the dead-letter queue (DLQ count baseline + 1 and the taskId read back, never deleted) and the DLQ alarm; one valid embedding-task-v1 task for the first key of researcher-profile-v1 in the scan order of the DynamoDB ArtifactRegistry table (M-01: no S3 Vectors data-plane call from the laptop), sent right after the poison so it is processed while the poison is retried (recovery), then sent again only after the worker logged 'processed' (expect 'replayed': idempotency by the completion record); and one API idempotency replay (POST /v1/query sync twice with one Idempotency-Key, then the same key with another body for 409). Writes incident-F.json with the spec's incident fields. No AWS change, no termination. Runs at the session 2 build commit and the D3 plan.
datasetSnapshot: dblp-2026-11-01 (DBLP XML with dblp.dtd), subset rule dblp-subset-v1 (datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml); the vectors of the Phase 14 export run=f2625d504b12749389cf4f5b1a26aed4 in researcher-profile-v1

resourceLimits.terraformSource: infra/terraform/modules/workflow/variables.tf (embedding_max_receive_count 5, embedding_visibility_seconds 300, dlq_retention_seconds); infra/terraform/modules/runtime/variables.tf (worker_max_count 2, worker_scale_in_minutes 5) and autoscaling.tf (worker step scaling on both queues); infra/terraform/modules/observability/alarms.tf (embedding DLQ alarm, period 300 s); API stage throttle in infra/terraform/environments/course (api_throttling_rate_limit 5, burst 10)

notes: APPROVAL: the human signs this exact file at D9 with the line APPROVED-MANIFEST-SHA256: HEX64 in docs/agent-runs/phase-15/approvals.md; any change is a new sha256 and a new approval. Run in the terminal where SCHOLARCHAIN_SERVICE_API_KEY is exported (part 3). COST (estimate): under $0.05: one LLM query for part 3 (about $0.0023 per query, Phase 10 attempt-06 average tokens at the Haiku rates; the replay is served from the stored answer and the 409 runs no query), two Voyage embeddings of one document (free allowance), one worker task for about 20 to 30 minutes (about $0.04 per task-hour, infra 5a, estimate) and the metric export; costBoundUsd 0.1. DURATION: the tool's own deadline 4,200 s (part limits from the queue settings it reads: poison = 480 s scale-out allowance + (maxReceiveCount 5 + 1) x 60 s release cycles + 120 s DLQ count lag = 960 s; each replay wait 720 s counted from the start of that wait, not from the replay send (repair-01, finding J-01: the first wait starts after part 1, which can end later than 720 s after the replay send; the worker log is read at least once per wait, from 60 s before the replay send, so a 'processed' line written while part 1 ran is found); recovery 600 s; DLQ alarm 900 s after the DLQ arrival; worst case 960 + 720 + 720 + about 110 (part 3) + 600 + 900 = about 4,010 s, inside the deadline); maxDurationSeconds 4,800. KEY SELECTION (changed in repair-01, finding M-01): the vector bucket policy (infra/terraform/modules/vectors/main.tf, DataPlaneOnlyForRuntimeAndOps) explicitly denies ListVectors and GetVectors to every principal except the query, worker and ops task roles, so the laptop profile's list-vectors and get-vectors would be refused in the run and in --preflight. Orchestrator decision, no security change: the valid key is the first unique key of researcher-profile-v1 in a bounded, read-only, eventually consistent Scan of the DynamoDB ArtifactRegistry table (Terraform output dynamodb_table_names.ArtifactRegistry; FilterExpression begins_with(pk, 'artifact#vector#researcher-profile-v1/'), projection pk; the same rule as C with N = 1); its latest registry version (Query, ScanIndexForward=false, Limit 1) must hold textHash, embeddingModel and embeddingDimensions with the configured model and dimensions (else exit 3, nothing sent), and that textHash keys the completion-record check. The vector metadata itself is checked by the handler (a missing field is a permanent failure, recorded). Selection read cost (estimate): one CLI call of at most 1,000 items evaluated per request, typically a few hundred read request units, under $0.001. METRICS: the SQS series of the embedding queue, its DLQ, the job queue and its DLQ seen in account (aws-api list-metrics, 6b); AWS/ECS CPUUtilization, MemoryUtilization and LiveTaskCount with ClusterName and ServiceName seen in account for the query, evidence and graph services (the worker has not run in the retention window, so its series is not listed yet; an empty series stays missing); DynamoDB ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits of the query-session table seen in account. Task counts come from the collector's describe-services samples (Container Insights is off). LIMITATIONS known in advance: the worker's per-delivery log field names (taskId, outcome, stream prefix worker/) were checked in 6c against the rag and service handoffs and match the collector constants; the textHash used for the completion-record check is the latest registry version's, assumed equal to the vector's stored metadata (the ingest registers a version after PutVectors with the same metadata); 'replayed' is proven only by the worker log, so an unreadable log makes the replay 'unverified'; the poison limit assumes the release-at-once rule (decision 7.2): without it the poison needs about 5 x 300 s and is reported 'not seen within the limit'; the DLQ alarm has a 300 s period, so detection lags the DLQ arrival by up to about 10 minutes; overlapping duplicates are a unit-test matter (decision 6.5), not part of F.
